title: Remedy Meds reviews: BBB record, billing and FutureClinic - FutureClinic
summary: Remedy Meds reviews: November 2026 BBB record, billing, cancelling and guarantee terms, and a $40 FutureClinic visit, FDA-approved GLP-1s at your pharmacy.
body_markdown:
The clinicians who prescribe at Remedy Meds work for independent practices, including ones it names such as OpenLoop Healthcare Partners; Remedy Meds LLC, started May 23, 2024, runs the GLP-1 program and says it doesn't practice medicine. The BBB rated Remedy Meds F in November 2026. A FutureClinic physician can prescribe[an FDA-approved GLP-1 by message](https://futureclinic.com/blog/weight-loss-medication-online-no-membership-fee) , no subscription required.


## Is Remedy Meds legit and who treats you?


The BBB lists Remedy Meds LLC in Summit, New Jersey, started May 23, 2024. Under the[Remedy Meds Terms of Service](https://remedymeds.com/legal/terms-of-service) (updated October 20, 2026, checked November 11, 2026), Remedy does not practice medicine; licensed clinicians at practices including OpenLoop Healthcare Partners, PC, JMP Medical, P.A., and KMG Medical Group MO, P.C. prescribe. The[Remedy Meds homepage](https://remedymeds.com/) calls them "Licensed clinicians experienced in GLP-1 medication & care" and "Licensed, certified physicians," while its "care team" is non-clinical. Remedy operates in 50 states and D.C. and lists "300,000+ members."


## What do Remedy Meds reviews and the BBB show?


As of November 11, 2026,[Remedy Meds LLC has an F BBB rating](https://www.bbb.org/us/nj/jersey-city/profile/health-care-referral/remedymeds-0221-90234778) , is not accredited, and averages 1.7 of 5 from 122[BBB customer reviews](https://www.bbb.org/us/nj/jersey-city/profile/health-care-referral/remedymeds-0221-90234778/customer-reviews) . The BBB says its grade is its opinion based on complaint history, transparency, and public data, citing its short time in business, its 496 complaints, and 10 unanswered and 25 unresolved complaints. The[BBB complaints page](https://www.bbb.org/us/nj/jersey-city/profile/health-care-referral/remedymeds-0221-90234778/complaints) lists 496 complaints, which are customer allegations, in three years (353 in 12 months): 393 answered, 68 resolved, 25 unresolved, and 10 unanswered (product 210, service/repair 123, billing 58, sales/advertising 38, order 29, delivery 25, customer service 13). Remedy states its testimonials are paid and weight loss is self-reported.


## What does Remedy Meds offer and how does care work?


Remedy sells compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide, a microdose plan ("half the dose, twice a week"), and brand names such as Ozempic and Zepbound at "Retail Pricing." After its quiz, "a real clinician builds your plan" within 24 hours, and medicine is delivered within two to three days. Plans include video calls, messaging, monthly check-ins, live expert sessions, recipes, and a community. Refill reviews may be asynchronous, and continued enrollment is consent if a clinician switches your product.


Remedy notes the FDA has not evaluated its compounded drugs.[The FDA states compounded drugs are not FDA approved](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/postmarket-drug-safety-information-patients-and-providers/fdas-concerns-unapproved-glp-1-drugs-used-weight-loss) and are for patients whose needs an approved drug cannot meet. After[resolving the tirzepatide and semaglutide shortages](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-alerts-and-statements/fda-clarifies-policies-compounders-national-glp-1-supply-begins-stabilize) by February 2025, it ended compounder grace periods, and in April 2026 said pharmacies may not regularly compound copies of available drugs unless a prescriber documents a significant difference for the patient.


## How do Remedy Meds billing, cancelling and its guarantee work?


Remedy Meds shows no price before its quiz (checked November 11, 2026); one upfront fee per term covers medicine and clinician access, paid by cash or HSA/FSA card without insurance. Monthly, 3-, 6-, or 12-month terms renew automatically, and billing may occur up to 10 days early. Refills ship every 28 days after a monthly refill form (every three months on the microdose plan), and charges continue even without a form or shipment. Cancel at least 48 hours before the term ends; paid terms are non-refundable unless a clinician finds you ineligible at enrollment.


Its "Weight Loss Warranty" ("Guaranteed or it's free" and "365-Day Money-Back Guarantee") refunds 12 months of fees only after 12 continuous months and 13 standard-dose compounded shipments if you miss your goal weight (at most 20% below starting weight and not below a BMI of 18.5), with a claim filed within 35 days of shipment 13 and proof of weight (a provider's written attestation or a self-recorded scale video); Remedy decides eligibility at its sole discretion. Brand GLP-1s, microdosing, or any lapse voids it.
